description: Vite/React/TS frontend (T10) + client-test.html update. A browser UI with a visible Examen/Conduite toggle, upload+preview, progress states, and rendering of the unified cards (exam = option cards + selection gauge; situation = intention cards Autorise/Interdit + probability + 1 KB excerpt), with a collapsible debug panel. Never shows raw JSON as the primary view. Also updates the zero-build client-test.html fallback to send mode and render the new shape. Depends on FEAT-002 (the unified response shape is the contract the UI renders). Independent of FEAT-003.
steps: Scaffold web/ as a Vite + React + TypeScript app: index.html, package.json (vite, react, react-dom, typescript, and vitest + @testing-library/react for the component test), vite.config.ts, src/main.tsx, src/types.ts (UnifiedResponse, Card, CardOption).

src/App.tsx: hold mode ('exam'|'situation', default exam), apiUrl (from VITE_API_URL), file, status (idle|authorizing|uploading|analyzing|done|error), result, error. Render a visible Examen/Conduite segmented toggle (radiogroup, keyboard accessible), a drop zone / camera input with preview, and progress states labelled perception -> reglement -> Decider.

src/api.ts: getUploadAuth() -> POST {VITE_API_URL}/uploads; uploadToS3() -> presigned POST; query(mode, s3Key, contentType) -> POST {VITE_API_URL}/query with body {mode, content_type, s3_key}. Mirror client-test.html's three-step flow and size/type limits.

src/components/: ModeToggle.tsx, Uploader.tsx, SceneSummary.tsx, CardList.tsx, Card.tsx (title, kind badge, options with score bars = score*100% and a selected highlight; situation renders Autorise/Interdit + probability + one KB excerpt from debug.knowledge_references), DebugPanel.tsx (collapsible, consumes debug: visual_facts, knowledge_references, media_key, elapsed_ms). Score bars carry aria-label with the percentage; status uses aria-live=polite.

Add at least one component test (vitest + @testing-library/react) that renders an exam card and a situation card from a mock UnifiedResponse payload and asserts the title, the two/multiple options, and the selected highlight.

Update client-test.html (FR18 fallback): add a mode selector, send mode in the /query body, and render cards/scene_summary + dump debug instead of the old single JSON.stringify of {decision, visual_facts, ...}.
acceptance_criteria: `npm install && npm run build` in web/ succeeds (AC14 build).
`npm test` (vitest) passes with >=1 component test rendering an exam card and a situation card from a mock payload.
The UI toggles exam/situation, performs the upload->query flow, and renders cards with per-option scores and selection highlighting plus scene_summary; raw JSON is never the primary view (FR17).
client-test.html sends mode and renders the new cards/debug shape.
verification: cd web ; npm install ; npm run build
findings:
Done. Automated bar green: `cd web; npm install; npm run build` succeeds (tsc + vite, dist/ emitted) and `cd web; npm test -- --run` passes (2 component tests in src/components/Card.test.tsx render an exam card and a situation card from a mock UnifiedResponse, asserting title, all options, the selected highlight, score-bar aria-labels, and the KB excerpt on the situation card).

MANUAL CHECK STILL REQUIRED (cannot run in this environment, do at demo/deploy time): browser VISUAL verification of both modes (Examen/Conduite), error states (404 / network timeout), and responsive layout on desktop AND mobile. Also a live end-to-end run against a deployed API (set VITE_API_URL) to confirm the /uploads -> S3 POST -> /query flow and CORS.

Contract rendered (from FEAT-002, authoritative): unified shape {mode, cards, scene_summary, debug{visual_facts, knowledge_references, media_key, elapsed_ms}}. Card = {id, title, kind('choice'|'allow_deny'), options[]{label, score(0..1), selected}}. Situation verdict labels are the ACCENTED 'Autorisé' and 'Interdit' (matches FEAT-002 present.py exactly). /query body sent as {mode, content_type, s3_key}; /uploads returns {upload_url, fields, s3_key, content_type}.

Implementation notes for later steps:
- web/ is a Vite + React 18 + TS app. VITE_API_URL drives the API base (read in src/api.ts and src/App.tsx); unset => a visible 'VITE_API_URL n'est pas configurée' banner and the API calls throw before fetch. Build script is `tsc && vite build` (NOT `tsc -b`, which needs composite/project refs).
- Score bars: width = round(score*100)% and carry aria-label '<label> : <pct>%'; status region uses role=status aria-live=polite; ModeToggle is a role=radiogroup with role=radio buttons (keyboard/aria-checked). Progress stages labelled perception -> règlement -> Decider.
- Situation KB excerpt: Card renders references[index].text where references = debug.knowledge_references, mapped by card index in CardList (situation only). Raw JSON lives ONLY in the collapsible DebugPanel (<details>), never as the primary view (FR17).
- client-test.html (FR18 fallback) updated: added a mode radio (Examen/Conduite), sends `mode` in the /query body, and renders scene_summary + cards (with score bars, selected highlight, situation KB excerpt) + a collapsible debug <pre>, instead of the old single JSON.stringify. The error path still dumps JSON into #result.
- npm install reported esbuild postinstall blocked by allowScripts, but the esbuild native binary was already present so build+test both ran clean; a fresh clone may need `npm install` to run esbuild's postinstall.
- Committed web/ source + package-lock.json + modified client-test.html; node_modules/ and dist/ excluded via web/.gitignore. No Python touched, so the Python suite was not re-run (out of FEAT-004 scope).
